title: Sample Quiz from JSON
description: This is an example of how to structure quiz data in JSON format for import into the application.

questions.question: Which HTTP status code indicates a successful request?
questions.explanation: HTTP status code 200 indicates a successful request.

questions.question: Which of the following are JavaScript frameworks? (Select all that apply)
questions.explanation: React, Angular, and Vue.js are JavaScript frameworks. Django and Laravel are backend frameworks.

questions.question: JSON stands for JavaScript Object Notation.
questions.explanation: JSON indeed stands for JavaScript Object Notation.

questions.question: The ______ method is used to add an element to the end of an array in JavaScript.
questions.explanation: The push() method adds one or more elements to the end of an array.

questions.question: What is the difference between let and var in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: The main differences are scope (block vs function) and hoisting behavior.

questions.question: Match the HTML tags with their purposes:
questions.explanation:
for headings,

for paragraphs, for images, for links

questions.question: Arrange these CSS properties in the order they appear in the box model (from outside to inside):
questions.explanation: CSS box model order from outside to inside: Margin, Border, Padding, Content
